---
# Cards are generated from each project's frontmatter by ../_project-card.ejs.
# Per-project fields it reads: title, subtitle (falls back to description),
# years, and priority (sort order, ascending).
title: "Projects"
description: "Research and engineering projects: connectome analysis, behavioural data pipelines, interactive web resources and reproducible scientific workflows."
# `full` widens the content column so the 3-up grid isn't squeezed into the
# 720px reading measure used elsewhere; custom.scss caps it at 1040px.
page-layout: full
# Card titles are <h3>. Without this, anchor-sections injects an <a> into each
# one — nested inside the card's own <a>, which is invalid HTML.
anchor-sections: false
listing:
  - id: projects
    template: ../_project-card.ejs
    contents:
      - "*.qmd"
      - "!index.qmd"
    sort: "priority asc"
---

A selection of my experimental and data science projects.

::: {#projects}
:::
